title: Payment of an Elected Commuted Value — Income Annuities Claims Desk Guide
content:
The commuted value a beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract has elected is paid in one sum to that beneficiary, by the method the election asks for, while the contract status is death claim pending or beneficiary continuing.

**Standing condition.** The commuted value is not paid until a commutation election signed by the beneficiary stands approved on the contract.

Restated in the same terms: so long as the contract's service requests show no approved commutation election signed by the beneficiary, there is no commuted value to pay.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Payee | The beneficiary who elected the commuted value |
| Form | One sum |
| Method | The method the election asks for |
| Contract status | Death claim pending or beneficiary continuing; in any other status the lump sum is not paid |
| Election | Signed by the beneficiary and standing approved on the contract |

**Effect.** The payment appears on the contract's activity history as a commuted value paid against the beneficiary's commutation election, with the gross commuted value and the amount actually sent, and the contract's unreturned purchase amount falls by the gross amount.

## Paying the commuted value: `pay_commuted_value_cb4f45b9`

**Capability.** Pays the commuted value of the remaining certain installments of an Ashgrove period-certain income annuity to the beneficiary who elected it. One call books the lump-sum payment on the contract's activity history against the beneficiary's commutation election, with the gross commuted value and the amount actually sent after federal and state tax withholding, and lowers the contract's unreturned purchase amount by the gross amount. The beneficiary sees the payment at once.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `income_contract_id` — the reference number of the income annuity contract, from the income annuity contract lookup. Identifier as recorded.
- `income_request_id` — the reference number of the beneficiary's approved commutation election on the contract, as shown on the election's receipt or in the income annuity service request lookup. Identifier as recorded.
- `payee_name` — the beneficiary's full name exactly as the customer profile lookup shows it, copied character for character.
- `payment_method` — how the lump sum is sent: `check` (a paper check mailed) or `direct_deposit` (to the deposit account on the contract's payment instructions).
- `commuted_amount` — the gross commuted value paid, before any tax withholding, in USD with 2 decimal places.
- `net_paid_amount` — the amount actually sent after federal and state tax withholding, in USD with 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A receipt line beginning "Paid commuted value", naming the contract and election reference numbers, the new activity entry reference number, the gross commuted value and the net amount sent in USD with 2 decimal places. That receipt means the payment is booked.
